title: KNOTS
note: DRESS THE KNOT (NO CROSSED STRANDS), PULL IT TIGHT, LEAVE A TAIL OF A FEW INCHES.

items.title: BOWLINE
items.use: FIXED LOOP THAT WON'T SLIP OR JAM
steps: MAKE A SMALL OVERHAND LOOP IN THE STANDING PART, WORKING END ON TOP.
UP THROUGH THE LOOP FROM BELOW · THE RABBIT COMES OUT OF THE HOLE.
AROUND BEHIND THE STANDING PART · AROUND THE TREE.
BACK DOWN THROUGH THE SMALL LOOP · BACK DOWN THE HOLE.
HOLD THE BIG LOOP AND PULL THE STANDING PART TO SET IT.
items.tip: EASY TO UNTIE AFTER A LOAD. CAN SHAKE LOOSE WHEN NOT LOADED. ADD A STOPPER IN THE TAIL.

items.title: CLOVE HITCH
items.use: QUICK HITCH TO A POST OR RAIL
steps: WRAP THE END AROUND THE POST.
CROSS OVER THE STANDING PART AND WRAP AROUND AGAIN.
TUCK THE END UNDER THAT SECOND WRAP.
PULL BOTH ENDS. IT FORMS AN X ON THE FRONT.
items.tip: FAST AND ADJUSTABLE BUT CAN SLIP ON A TURNING POST. ADD TWO HALF HITCHES TO SECURE IT.

items.title: SQUARE KNOT
items.use: TIE TWO ENDS AROUND A BUNDLE
steps: RIGHT OVER LEFT AND UNDER.
LEFT OVER RIGHT AND UNDER.
PULL TIGHT. BOTH ENDS EXIT ON THE SAME SIDE.
items.tip: FOR BINDING, NOT FOR JOINING TWO ROPES UNDER LOAD. USE A SHEET BEND FOR THAT.

items.title: SHEET BEND
items.use: JOIN TWO ROPES, EVEN DIFFERENT SIZES
steps: FOLD A BIGHT IN THE THICKER ROPE.
THINNER END UP THROUGH THE BIGHT FROM BELOW.
AROUND BEHIND BOTH SIDES OF THE BIGHT.
TUCK UNDER ITSELF, NOT THROUGH THE BIGHT.
PULL THE STANDING PARTS. TAILS END UP ON THE SAME SIDE.
items.tip: DOUBLE IT (WRAP TWICE) FOR SLICK OR VERY UNEQUAL ROPES.

items.title: TWO HALF HITCHES
items.use: TIE OFF TO A RING, POST OR TREE
steps: PASS THE END AROUND THE POST OR THROUGH THE RING.
OVER THE STANDING PART, UNDER, AND BACK THROUGH THE GAP · ONE HALF HITCH.
SAME DIRECTION AGAIN FARTHER ALONG · THE SECOND.
SLIDE THEM SNUG TO THE POST.
items.tip: A ROUND TURN FIRST (TWO WRAPS) TAKES THE LOAD OFF THE HITCHES.

items.title: TAUT-LINE HITCH
items.use: ADJUSTABLE LOOP FOR GUY LINES, TARPS
steps: PASS THE END AROUND THE STAKE.
WRAP IT TWICE AROUND THE STANDING PART, WORKING TOWARD THE STAKE.
ONE MORE WRAP AROUND THE STANDING PART, OUTSIDE THE FIRST TWO.
PULL SNUG. SLIDE THE KNOT TO TIGHTEN OR LOOSEN THE LINE.
items.tip: HOLDS UNDER LOAD, SLIDES WHEN THE LOAD IS OFF.

items.title: TRUCKER'S HITCH
steps: TIE ONE END TO THE TRUCK OR ANCHOR.
PART WAY ALONG, MAKE A FIXED LOOP IN THE ROPE (SLIPPED OVERHAND OR ALPINE BUTTERFLY).
FREE END AROUND THE SECOND ANCHOR AND BACK UP THROUGH THAT LOOP.
PULL DOWN ON THE FREE END · A 2:1 PULLEY.
HOLD THE TENSION, LOCK OFF WITH TWO HALF HITCHES AT THE ANCHOR.
items.tip: THE LOOP TAKES WEAR. CHECK IT BEFORE REUSING THE ROPE.

items.title: FIGURE-8 LOOP
steps: FOLD A BIGHT, THE SIZE OF LOOP YOU WANT.
WITH THE DOUBLED ROPE, MAKE A LOOP.
WRAP THE BIGHT BEHIND THE STANDING PARTS.
PASS IT DOWN THROUGH THE FIRST LOOP · IT LOOKS LIKE AN 8.
DRESS THE STRANDS PARALLEL. PULL ALL FOUR TIGHT.
items.tip: HOLDS WELL BUT JAMS AFTER A HEAVY LOAD. TO TIE AROUND SOMETHING, USE A FIGURE-8 FOLLOW-THROUGH.
